articles.title: ChatGPT developer OpenAI said to discuss offering U.S. government a 5% stake: FT
articles.snippet: The proposal aims to give the American public a financial stake in AI while easing political scrutiny of the industry.

articles.title: Ripple co-founder backs venture launched by US senator's son: Report
articles.snippet: While engaged in negotiations over ethics in a crypto market structure bill in Congress, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said she had “no involvement” in her son’s derivatives exchange, backed by at least one industry figure.

articles.title: OpenAI Offers US Government a $42 Billion Slice of Itself: Report
articles.snippet: Sam Altman is pitching a 5% equity stake in OpenAI for the U.S. government—and reportedly wants every major AI company to do the same.

articles.title: Scattered Spider Suspect Extradited to US Over $8M Crypto Ransom Demand
articles.snippet: The teenager allegedly helped to breach a luxury jeweler and demand $8 million in crypto, as part of a crew tied to $100 million in ransoms.
